notes.title: Revise the tasks of building a hospital and rescuing people.
notes.content:
[h3]Optimize：[/h3]
Revise the task requirements for building a hospital by reducing the required funds and increasing the amount of wood and iron ore materials.
Revise the task of arranging medical treatment outside of prison for Mingzhu by reducing the required funds.
[h3]Fix：[/h3]
Fix the issue where nurses appear on the mini-map when the hospital is not unlocked.

notes.title: Add hospital and three female characters.
notes.content:
[h3]Optimization[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]The back mountain passage has added a new hospital building.[/b]
(After triggering the village chief's plot, returning to the doorstep will unlock a new mission.)
[*] [b]New female characters - Nurse[/b]
[*] [b]New female characters - Doctor[/b]
[*] [b]New female characters - Mingzhu[/b]
[/list]
[h3]WorkShop[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Remove the Creative Workshop store page in the game and only retain the function of creating mods.
[*] To subscribe to mods, you need to go to the Steam workshop page.
[*] The subscribed mods need to be watched on the TV in the house in the game.[/b]
[/list]
[h3]After this update, we will be launching the game as an official version. This also means that Country Carnival will officially come to an end. We would like to thank everyone for their valuable feedback during the game's development. Although many ideas did not make it into the game for various reasons, they have opened up new avenues of thought for us to create new games in the future.[/h3]

[h3]If you encounter any issues while playing the game, you can join our official group and private message the administrator. We will promptly help you resolve any problems.[/h3]

[h3]Lastly, we would like to thank everyone for their support towards the game, and wish you all a pleasant gaming experience.[/h3]

tags.feature: [b]The back mountain passage has added a new hospital building.[/b]
[b]New female characters - Nurse[/b]
[b]New female characters - Doctor[/b]
[b]New female characters - Mingzhu[/b]
[b]Remove the Creative Workshop store page in the game and only retain the function of creating mods.
To subscribe to mods, you need to go to the Steam workshop page.
The subscribed mods need to be watched on the TV in the house in the game.

notes.title: Hot spring map update
notes.content:
Villagers have a chance to appear on the map of the hot spring during the day or night.
You can check whether there are people in the hot spring on the small map. If you want to change people, you can sleep and refresh.

notes.title: Recent update plan - 2022/10/8
notes.content:
[h1] Near term plan [/h1]
Including but not limited to the following:
1. Press shift or click icon to switch between "walking" and "running"
2. Open the map to see the NPC location and whether there are currently available tasks
3. Shy things will move to more reasonable areas
4. You can watch Shugen Family's "Meat Pie Making" again
5. Difference between plots after strengthening watering
6. Shorten the ripening time of crops
7. Display the countdown days of ripeness when pointing at crops
8. Extend the passage of time
9. Enrich NPC dialogue
10. It is tentatively planned to add a shyness pose for each NPC (this will be completed at the end of the month)
[h1] Next phase plan [/h1]
1. The production of items will be opened by the carpenter (such as "automatic watering tools")
2. Allow changing clothes when you are shy
3. Contents of the Map of Hot Spring Development
4. As stated in the store profile, updating the text volume to a stable version will promote CV dubbing
